name: White Wonder Ivy
description: Hedera helix 'White Wonder' is a variegated cultivar of English ivy with grey-green, mid-green, dark green and cream foliage. It is a vigorous evergreen climber in the Araliaceae family, suited to semi-shade or shade and moist, well-drained soil. It tolerates various soil types and alkaline to neutral pH. Ideal for terrariums, hanging baskets, or as a climbing accent. Mildly toxic if ingested.
careTips: Bright indirect light or semi-shade; avoid harsh direct sun; can drop leaves if too dark
Keep soil moist but well-drained; avoid waterlogging
Well-draining mix; tolerates chalk, clay, loam, or sand; pH 6.5–7.5
Moderate humidity; adapts to average indoor humidity
Cool to moderate temperatures; hardy in USDA zones 5–6; avoid hot dry drafts
Trim to control size; stems root easily when in contact with moist substrate
Toxic if ingested—keep away from pets and children
